row: Welcome! It's great to meet you!  We are Fit For Life Physiotherapy, a multidisciplinary clinic that has been serving the Aldershot, Hamilton and Burlington communities since 2009. We have Physiotherapists, Osteopathic Manual Practitioners, Registered Massage Therapists, Kinesiologist, Yoga Therapist, Certified Pedorthist and Registered Dietitian, all under one roof working towards our goal of helping the community move well, live well and be well!
